description: GuaranteedServiceTimeInventoryModel publishes a Gurobi implementation of a guaranteed-service-time inventory model with 38 real-world supply-chain instances. The repository includes instance data, network structures, variable values, objective summaries and Python entry points. Its Data_In_Brief README explains how to select instances, obtain service levels and guaranteed service times, set inventory holding costs and limit branch-and-cut runtime. It also documents network degree, depth and stage-category plots. The instances serve as reusable network benchmarks; the repository does not establish one geographic coverage, observation period or time resolution for all chains. Public GitHub access is free. Zenodo labels its archive Other (Open) without specifying complete terms; GitHub has no licence file. Running the optimisation also requires Gurobi under its own terms. The documented runtime limit can leave solutions unfinished; optimality should be checked per instance. No solver was run in this review. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing safety-stock placement under changed network or service assumptions. model-supplynetpy provides a related simulation-based inventory approach, with no demonstrated interoperability.
